title: Python Set Exercise - GeeksforGeeks
content:
Python set exercises helps to practice working with sets through real coding problems. These questions cover important concepts such as creating sets, set operations, updating sets and working with unique elements to strengthen your problem-solving skills.

Example Programs

  • Size of Set
  • Iterating over Set
  • Max & Min
  • Removing Items
  • Set into Tuple & Tuple into Set
  • Set into List
  • Set into String
  • String into Set
  • Set into Dictionary
  • Subsets of given Size

Practice Problems

  • Operations
  • Set
  • Multiset Operations
  • Union of Arrays with Duplicates
  • Distinct Elements
  • Smaller on Left

Quiz

  • Set quiz
